title: 3 tests call _handle_message_3 with wrong signature (4 args instead of 3)
description: Tests call _handle_message_3(peer_host, msg3, session_key, session) but method signature is _handle_message_3(peer_host, msg3, session). Affected tests: test_expired_message_3_is_rejected_without_publication, test_failed_message_3_is_removed_and_fresh_handshake_succeeds, test_publication_failure_cleans_session_without_publishing. Fix: remove session_key from test calls, as method extracts it from session['key'].
